title.zh: Ethereum News | Ethereum Staking Exit Queue Hits 2026 High With Nearly 800K ETH Waiting to Withdraw

current_state.zh: Ethereum's staking exit queue has climbed to a 2026 high with roughly 800,000 ETH queued for withdrawal, pointing to elevated validator unstaking demand and a lengthening wait to exit.
